D5/S3/Fourier/BiquadraticKroneckerTimes..signature: theorem dense_circle_sequence {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] (a : ι → ℝ) (hind : ∀ (k : ι → ℤ) (m : ℤ), (∑ i, (k i : ℝ)*a i) = m → (∀ i, k i = 0)) (z : ι → Circle) : ∃ m : ℕ → ℕ, Tendsto (fun n i => Circle.exp (2*Real.pi*a i)^(m n)) atTop (𝓝 z)
